newsitem.title: USA: Keystone files with SEC for 3.8 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Keystone files with SEC for 3.8 mln shrs.

text.p: Keystone Automotive Industries Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 3.8 million common shares, of which it will sell 1.5 million shares and a group of shareholders including the company's chairman will sell 2.3 million shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Morgan Keegan & Co Inc, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc, and Crowell Weedon & Co, have an over-allotment option of up to 570,000 common shares.
The Pomona, Calif. car parts distributor said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells to reduce bank debt and any remaining portion would be used for general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 11.25 million common shares outstanding. Shares traded late Friday at 15 1/2.
